key_idea: If k >= 2 a DFS walk traverses every edge exactly twice, so everything is collectable; if k = 1 the walk is a simple path, so the answer is the weighted diameter.
sketch: Read the tree and sum all edge weights. For k >= 2 print the sum. For k = 1 run two BFS/DFS passes (farthest node from any node, then farthest from that) to get the weighted diameter. O(N). Pitfalls: use 64-bit sums (up to 2e14), iterative traversal to avoid stack overflow on a path of 2e5 nodes, and N = 1 gives 0.
